notes: The native notice identifies the origin during real DOM fullscreen in the original window.
The page fills the existing surface on a second entry. Escape restores the previous viewport in fullscreen-restored-2.
The original moving VP8 video with Opus audio floats over the next tab.
The GTK Pause button stops the video clock and changes to Play.
GTK initially anchors the live player at the lower right.
The Move up action anchors the live player at the upper right.
The Move left action crosses to the upper left while the original video continues.
The Move down action anchors the original video in the lower left without a reload.
GTK removes its in-window surface while the original playhead advances.
The native Back to tab button activates the original document and docks the video without a reload.
Base Wayland offers no client-controlled global PiP positioning or always-on-top. GTK uses its own browser surface.
